mapper.select: SELECT a.*, s.student_no, s.name as student_name, c.class_name, co.course_name FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN student s ON a.student_id = s.student_no LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.class_code LEFT JOIN course_arrangement ca ON a.course_arrangement_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN course co ON ca.course_code = co.course_code WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, s.student_no, s.name as student_name, c.class_name, co.course_name FROM attendance a LEFT JOIN student s ON a.student_id = s.student_no LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.class_code LEFT JOIN course_arrangement ca ON a.course_arrangement_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN course co ON ca.course_code = co.course_code WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY a.attendance_date DESC
